description: The ASPERN rating of one vault: an overall letter (A+ best … D worst) from eight component letters with published weights (control and governance 20, exit liquidity 15, collateral quality 15, borrower credit 10, oracle 10, concentration 10, transparency and data evidence 10, track record 10), each with the inputs and the threshold that set it and the vault-page section that grounds it. Caps are rules and are listed where they applied (sanctions match, impaired market, unbounded control, the published band, a component at D, band withheld, control or exit not rated). A component without a usable reading is not rated, never given a default letter; coverage says how many were rated. Read from the vault’s latest stored due-diligence document, whose time and digest come with it; the overall is never better than that document’s published band allows. A model output over on-chain data: not a credit rating, not a probability of loss. Free.

slug.description: The vault slug or contract address, as list_vaults returns it.

name: vault_rating

disclaimer.description: Not a credit rating, not a probability of loss, not advice.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

rating.description: overall (rating, state rated | not_rated, weightedPoints, beforeCaps, caps [{code, ceiling, says}], notRatedBecause), coverage (rated, applicable, total, ratedWeightShare, says), components [{key, name, weight, state rated | not_rated | not_applicable, rating, restsOn, inputs [{label, value}], rule, says, notRatedBecause, section {anchor, label}}], band (published, weightedModel, status, ceiling, says), source (issued | computed_on_read), issuedAs ({version, rating} where the document was issued under an older rating version), says, disclaimer. Null where no due-diligence document is stored.

report.description: The document it is read from: digest, day, readAt, ageHours, current, says.

says.description: The rating in one sentence, with the document it comes from.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it, each {code, message, says} with message and says the same sentence. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.

title: A vault’s ASPERN rating
